summary: First test run of VEDED. Backend: 20/20 pytest cases pass (auth, config/pricing, image gen with real NVIDIA FLUX.1-dev + flux-schnell fallback, media JPEG, gallery, publish→discover, chat, video 503, UPI payment initiate/submit/mine, admin approve, 402 credits guard, 403 non-admin). Frontend: landing, register→auto-redirect /studio, image generation live-hits NVIDIA and renders result-image (credits 60→54, toast 'Image ready · -6 credits'), Pricing page renders 4 plan CTAs, Pro CTA routes to /billing?kind=plan&item=pro with UPI QR showing 9673856312@upi + reference note VEDED-xxxxxxxx, Discover loads categories. No blocking issues found.

minor.issue: NVIDIA hosted endpoint occasionally returns 422/HTML transient errors → surfaced as 502 to client. Frontend should show a retry-friendly message; server could retry once internally.
Response contains no image dimensions/created_at; harmless but gallery already returns them.

issues: Credits label rendered as '60credits' without space between number and label in [data-testid=studio-credits]. Cosmetic.
Success toast partially overlaps the top-nav 'Studio' link visually. Minor z-index/margin tweak.

action_items: Optional: internal single-retry in ai_client.generate_image() for transient upstream 422/5xx (NVIDIA is flaky).
Cosmetic: add space between credit count and 'credits' label in Studio header (studio-credits testid).
Cosmetic: shift toast container below the top nav or increase margin-top to avoid overlap.
critical_code_review_comments: server.py hardcodes 60 free credits; consider moving to config for future adjustments.
ai_client.py has no retry/backoff; hosted NVIDIA endpoints are known to return transient 422/5xx.
get_current_user hits DB per request — fine for MVP but consider caching or JWT-only claims for hot paths.
admin/payments/{id}/approve does not roll back user credits update if payments.update_one fails (no transaction). Low risk given single-doc idempotency check on 'approved'.
test_credentials: admin@veded.app / VededAdmin@2026 (seeded); test users created dynamically via /api/auth/register with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Multiple TEST_ prefixed users and a couple of TEST published media entries were created during the run. Media created: at least 2 image docs (small/large). One UPI payment approved (user promoted to pro plan +1800 credits).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/veded_backend_test.py — runs in ~9s serially (`-n 0`) when NVIDIA is fast, up to ~90s worst case. Uses pymongo direct DB access to zero credits for the 402 test (backend lowercases emails on register — filter by email.lower()). Frontend routes are /login and /register (NOT /auth). Data-testids used: auth-name, auth-email, auth-password, auth-submit, prompt-input, generate-btn, result-image, studio-credits, plan-cta-{free|starter|pro|studio}, upi-qr. Landing page title is still 'Emergent | Fullstack App' — main agent may want to set proper <title>.
rca_of_the_issue: N/A — no blocking issues. Two flaky/cosmetic items noted above.
